description: Human developer parameters, low tier (junior developer). See paper/main.tex tab:scenario:human. H_capacity, c_comm, H_monitoring_overhead, f_fix and d_qa are skill-independent and identical across tiers. r_bugs_human is an absolute per-feature bug rate, not a scale factor on the agent rate. f_qa, h_qa and d_qa drive the human quality-assurance stage of the human-only baseline (Section 4.1) and are read only by a team with no agents at all.
